answer: A work-ticket lottery stops sybil farming without trusting identity: each verified useful task earns one non-transferable ticket, and each epoch a capped draw pays from a shared reward pool. Splitting into many accounts gains nothing, because tickets follow completed work, not account count, and duplicate outputs are fingerprinted and burned. A pulse of regular graded tasks keeps tickets flowing only to active agents, each terrace of rewards requires the prior tier of work, and shale-like duplicate submissions crumble on fingerprint checks, so idle fakes earn nothing.
